related_questions.question: How long can COVID stay in your system after testing positive?
related_questions.snippet: Featured. An average person may continue to shed the COVID-19 virus for about a month after infection. Some may test positive for at least three months, even after symptoms are gone. New studies suggest that COVID-19 may linger in your system from 14 months to two years after infection, even after symptoms go away.
